name: uni-blender-scene
description: Blender scene creation and review for Codex, Claude Code, and other agent harnesses, powered by shared Skills and MCP.

interface.longDescription: Use shared Skills and one MCP service across Codex and Claude Code. Plan scenes from images or text, source objects from separately configured 3D API Providers, and confirm gray composition previews before materials and lighting. Deliver editable Blender scenes, renders and GLBs, with interactive previews in MCP Apps hosts.
defaultPrompt: Reconstruct this scene from all reference views. Use available 3D API Providers for standalone objects, confirm generation costs, verify spatial relationships, and pause after composition for my approval before materials.
